title: Leisuredome Ashbourne
description: Indoor soft play centre for kids located in Ashbourne, County Meath, offering a kids zone with softplay equipment to keep children entertained.

title: The Kildare Maze
description: Leinster’s largest hedge maze located just outside Prosperous in North Kildare. Offers a hedge maze, wooden maze, crazy golf, obstacle course, picnic area, and zip wire for a fun family day out in the countryside.

title: Castle Adventure Open Farm
description: Castle Adventure Open Farm is a family-friendly open farm near Ballyshannon, set in the original farmyard of Wardtown Castle on the Rossnowlagh Road. Visitors can meet and feed farm animals, enjoy petting time, outdoor play structures and indoor soft play, and the on-site cafe serves food and coffee — a popular spot for a full family day out.
age_group: Toddlers and young children (family day out)

title: Kidspace Indoor Playcentre, Rathcoole
description: Indoor children's play centre in Rathcoole, Dublin (the caption's #kidspacerathcoole references Kidspace Playcentre). It has a large multi-storey play frame with slides, ball pools, climbing decks and a zip line, plus separate soft play areas aimed at babies up to around 10 years old. Parents can sit in the café area while kids play, and there is free parking on site. A reliable rainy-day family outing in south-west Dublin, open year-round.

title: Rathwood
description: Rathwood is a family-friendly destination in County Carlow featuring a teddy bear picnic experience. The venue offers a family of 4 experience for less than €50 (one child, one baby), making it an affordable outing for young families.

title: Tick-Tock Activity Farm
description: Family-run activity farm near Arklow, County Wicklow, open since 2007 and catering for toddlers up to about 10 year olds. Kids can meet the farmyard animals, visit the pet corner, paint on the activity bus, and enjoy the indoor and outdoor play areas plus tractors. A regularly recommended day out for young families, praised as a wholesome little farm kids love.

title: The Treehouse Soft Play Centre
description: The Treehouse Soft Play Centre is an indoor soft play facility located at Hidden Valley Resort in County Wicklow. It is open to the public daily, making it a reliable any-day option for families with young children looking for indoor play in the Wicklow area.

title: Explorium – National Sport & Science Centre
description: Hands-on science centre in Sandyford, Dublin, promoting itself as Ireland's National Science Centre for all ages, with 250+ interactive exhibits and live science shows. Posted by @Explorium Ireland in the caption (the venue itself), tagged in a visit to their 'Late Lab' event. Family-friendly day out in south Dublin, easily reached from the city centre with free on-site parking.

title: Birr Castle Demesne
description: Historic castle demesne and gardens in Birr, Co. Offaly, famous for Ireland's tallest treehouse, the Great Telescope (Leviathan of Parsonstown, the world's largest telescope for over 70 years), Victorian gardens and cascades/waterfalls, and the Historic Science Centre museum. Outdoor play, woodland walks and science exhibits make it a popular family day out; check opening times and admission before visiting.

title: Explorium - National Sports & Science Centre
description: Ireland's National Sports & Science Centre, Explorium, located in Sandyford, Dublin. An interactive science and sports centre for families.

title: The Play Villa
description: An indoor play venue for children located on Ashbourne's high street in County Meath, Ireland.

title: Explorium – Ireland's National Science Centre (Junior Town)
description: Explorium in Sandyford, Dublin is Ireland's National Science Centre, a large indoor family attraction combining interactive science exhibits, sports challenges, adventure zones and climbing with hands-on discovery for all ages. The Junior Town, which the caption highlights, is a permanent new area designed for toddlers and younger children (ages 2–7), with big adventures scaled for little explorers. It's an everyday, bookable attraction — open year-round as a day-out destination — not a one-off event.
age_group: Junior Town: 2-7; venue caters to all ages

title: Explorium Dublin
description: National Sport and Science Centre in Sandyford, Dublin featuring hands-on interactive science exhibits and sport challenges for children and families. Highlighted as toddler-friendly with activities for small kids.

title: Airfield Estate
description: Airfield Estate is Dublin's urban working farm and gardens, open to the public year-round across 38 acres in Dundrum. Visitors can meet farmyard animals (sheep, pigs, goats, chickens), explore the working farmyard and dairy, wander food gardens and woodland walks, and enjoy nature play areas for kids — a family day out with a 'farm to fork' story and a charitable mission. Easily reachable from Dublin city centre via the Luas Green Line (Balally stop).

title: Explorium - Junior Area
description: Explorium is a science and sports discovery centre in Dublin with a dedicated Junior area designed for children under 7, where they can play and learn through interactive exhibits and activities.

title: Beyond the Trees Avondale
description: A Wicklow forest day with walking trails, a walled garden and the treetop experience. The site has free elements and bookable activities, so choose the version of the day that suits your budget and energy.
location: Avondale Forest Park, Rathdrum, Co. Wicklow

title: Lough Key Forest & Activity Park
description: Build a low-cost forest day around walking, cycling or a picnic, then add an activity only if it suits the plan. Some activities require advance booking.
location: Lough Key Forest Park, Boyle, Co. Roscommon

title: Explorium
description: An indoor Dublin option built around interactive science, sport and discovery activities. Choose the activity and session that fit your child’s age before booking.
